system: You are an expert PyTorch neural network architect.
Synthesise an improved model by combining the strongest structural elements from multiple reference implementations.
Output a complete, runnable Python class named 'Net' with all required LEMUR interface methods.
Use only standard PyTorch — no torchvision pre-built models.
prompt: CREATE an IMPROVED neural network by combining the best elements from these models:
1. Class name: 'Net' (unchanged), constructor: Net(in_shape, out_shape, prm, device)
2. Keep the LEMUR interface and its signatures: forward(x), train_setup(prm), learn(train_data)
3. Keep the module-level function supported_hyperparameters() returning a set (e.g. {{'lr', 'momentum'}}) and read every listed hyperparameter from prm (e.g. prm['lr'])
5. Input channels = in_shape[1], number of classes = out_shape[0]; do not assume a fixed image size (images may be resized, e.g. to 299x299): use adaptive pooling instead of hard-coded spatial sizes
6. Include every import you use (e.g. math, typing); the code must be complete and self-contained
IMPROVE by combining best features from all models above.
